content.comment_body: Today I was working with a User Defined Function (UDF). When creating the UDF, the platform automatically assigns default names to the IO points. Since my program uses several different IOs, I want to assign unique names to each input and output based on their purpose. I know that it's possible to modify IO names, but I can't figure out where this setting is available. Can anyone share some guidance on how to rename them? Kind regards, [user_name]
Go to the menu bar and choose Edit.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is attempting to rename IO points within a User Defined Function but is unable to locate the setting for customization. The user knows it is possible to adjust these names but cannot find the specific option and receives very brief guidance limited to a menu item.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the ability to easily rename IO points within a UDF, allowing for names that clarify each IO's function.
